ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark grey) base covering approximately 80% of surface area, contrasted by high-intensity (white/light grey) mottled patches primarily on the left lobe.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white mottled patch in the mid-lateral region of the left lobe; smaller discrete white focal clusters distributed across the right lobe; concentrations of high-intensity circular rings in the medial sections.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a vertex angle of approximately 50-60 degrees; lower portion of the notch vertex is obscured by water spray.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration profile along the entire visible trailing edge, characterized by jagged peaks and valleys with significant pixel-depth variations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical convex curves extending from the median notch to the distal tips, terminating in sharp, tapered points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High density of white circular ring-shaped clusters (barnacle scars) distributed across the lower medial and right-central fluke surfaces.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several distinct white linear scratches; notably a series of parallel rake marks on the distal region of the right lobe and scattered unaligned scratches on the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Calcified barnacle colonies visible as high-relief, irregular white/brown clusters attached to the extreme distal tips of both lobes; numerous circular scars and linear rake marks across the ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: A distinctive 'chevron' or 'V' shaped white mark located near the trailing edge of the right lobe, oriented toward the distal tip.
